discount.title: Apply discount
discount.description: This is only for students, academics and NGOs. Make sure to verify their status before applying discount (student/university email, NGO website, proof of non-profit, etc). They need to create their subscriptions before you can apply the 40% discount.

extend_trial.title: Extend trial
extend_trial.description: You can extend the trial of subscribers that are still in the trial period. Usually, you should not offer more than 7 days of trial, but you can add up to 14 days if needed.

password_reset.label: Reset Password
password_reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to send a password reset email?

two_factor_disable.title: Disable Two-Factor Authentication
two_factor_disable.warning: Disabling two-factor authentication is a critical security action. Make sure you have a solid reason and strong proof of account ownership (such as verified identity or written consent) before proceeding. The user will be required to re-enable 2FA on their next login.
two_factor_disable.reason_help: Reason will be sent to slack for internal use only.

payments.refund_notice_manual: We will not update to user. Please inform them manually.
payments.refund_notice_delay: After refund it will take some time to update this page.
payments.refund_reason_help: Please provide a clear reason for refunding this payment. This will be logged for future reference.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.cancel_notice: Ideally customers should cancel subscription themselves via the UI. If you cancel the subscription for them, please provide a reason.

subscriptions.cancel_confirm: Are you sure? This will cancel the subscription for this user.
